description: Data from: Transmission line data of different fault instances retrieved through Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) is a data set deposited in Dryad by its authors Simon Bin Akter, Tanmoy Sarkar Pias (North South University). This study presents a dataset comprising time series data pertaining to different electrical grid scenarios, encompassing both fault-free instances and occurrences of short circuits. The dataset was created by simulating various fault scenarios using the ePMU DSA tools and Matlab Simulink. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 21377794 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-dryad-repository.
